en.hubeali: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ibn Fazzal, from Hammad Bin usman, from Ibn Abu Yafour who said,

‘I said to Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> that Bazi’a is claiming that he is a Prophet. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘So if you were to hear him saying that, so kill him’. He (the narrator) said, ‘I sat awaiting more than once, but I was not able to do that’.
